hazards.control: Hands clear of handwheels, elevators, and tongs.

name: Casing connections
function: The threaded joints between casing joints that carry the tension, seal the pressure, and survive the frac pressure cycles.

tabs.overview: API connections (short and long round thread, buttress) and proprietary premium connections with metal seals; frac wells often use semi-premium or premium threads on the production string because of the pressure cycling.
tabs.engineering: Per API 5CT for API threads; make-up torque and thread compound per the connection.
tabs.safety: Make-up with power tongs; pinch points.
tabs.evidence: API Spec 5CT (S27), API Spec 10A (S28), API RP 10D-2 (S30), field practice (S9). Sizes are public nominal values; the schematic depth is not to scale.
